hints.title: Perimeter Loop Path
hints.text: The robot path cycles indefinitely along the outer boundary of the grid.

hints.title: Perimeter Modulo Simplification
hints.text: Reduce large step numbers by taking the remainder modulo the total perimeter distance.

hints.title: Origin Cycle Direction
hints.text: When returning to the bottom-left corner after completing a cycle, the robot faces South.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) for step, getPos, and getDir after perimeter initialization
complexity.space: O(width + height) storing boundary coordinates and directions
complexity.notes: The robot moves strictly along the perimeter forming a cyclic path.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating large step values up to 10^9 step-by-step causes time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modulo arithmetic on perimeter length reduces movement to O(1) index advancement.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the edge case where the robot cycles back to origin and faces South.
